submission.justification: Absorber-F3 at 5 mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.102% at 100 GeV among all tested configurations. This represents a ~25% improvement over the best F1 configuration (3.886% at 4 mm) and ~40% improvement over F2 (5.135% at 5 mm). The thickness of 5 mm is well within the specified 2-10 mm constraint. However, CRITICAL CAVEAT: The radiation dose rate requirement (≤20 µSv/h at 1 m after one week cooldown) could not be verified as no dose rate data was available. This recommendation assumes F3 meets radiation safety requirements and MUST be validated through proper radiation simulation or measurement before implementation.
